preconditions.description: The number of beads n must be between 1 and 1,000,000.
The number k must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: len(beads) == n and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in beads)
preconditions.description: The beads string must have a length equal to n and consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == n and all(c in '01' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output string must have a length equal to n and consist only of '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == '1' if is_regular(beads[:i+1], k) else stdout[i] == '0' for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each position i in the output string must be '1' if the first i+1 beads form a regular sequence, otherwise '0'.
